title: Saved git credentials
whyItMatters: This file stores git host logins and personal access tokens in plain text. Anyone who copies it can push to the person's repositories.
source: Git docs, git-credential-store: credentials are saved in ~/.git-credentials by default: https://git-scm.com/docs/git-credential-store
notes: One URL per line in the form https://user:token@host. Only exists when credential.helper is set to store; other helpers keep secrets elsewhere.

steps: Revoke any personal access tokens listed in the file from their respective Git hosting services.
Delete the file named in the plan using your file manager.
cleanup.risk: Removes saved Git HTTP authentication credentials and personal access tokens stored on disk.
